A presentation row inside an existing recipe table:
<pre>{{Recipe row
|ingredients={{Item|Plant Fiber|quantity=4}}
|output={{Item|Bandage|quantity=1}}
|methods=[[Inventory crafting]]
|ap=2
|conditions=Syntax example only.
}}</pre>
This is a syntax example, not a recipe. Separate multiple Item calls with <nowiki><br /></nowiki>. Fractional AP is supported; for another unit use cost instead of ap. Missing values display "Unknown", not zero. Output can describe in-place construction.

Keep onlyinclude/view/station filters and anchors on the output article, with the row call inside them. This template does not inherit caller parameters. Workstations transclude the filtered rows.
